# Ocean rhythm results

Run with `python -m scripts.run_ocean_rhythm`. The tables contain gap-aware periodicity, repeated seven-day motifs, abrupt changes, acoustic-only anomaly scores, and post-hoc external context. Open `interactive/index.html` in a browser after running. It intentionally contains no claimed original audio: this repository provides processed sound-level observations.
